chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when it was the day of al-Jumu'ah and he had not obtained any perfume, would call for a cloth dyed with saffron, sprinkle water upon it, then wipe it with his hand, then wipe his face with it.

key_terms.ثَوْبٍ مَصْبُوغٍ بِزَعْفَرَانٍ: a garment dyed with saffron, used here as a fragrant substitute
key_terms.وَجْهَهُ: his face, which he wiped with it
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, the weekly congregational worship day

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم do on Friday if he did not have perfume?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم on the day of al-Jumu'ah when perfume was unavailable. It reflects care for preparation and adornment for Jumu'ah through a permissible fragrant substitute.
